purpose: Integrate the shared Go configuration library used by OneClickVirt benchmark modules.
notes: Read go.mod and the exported Go types before changing consumers. Preserve compatibility with current benchmark modules; this library is not an independently runnable diagnostic.
purpose_zh: 在 Go 检测模块中使用共享配置库，并保持调用兼容。
notes_zh: 先阅读 go.mod 和导出类型，保持当前检测模块的调用兼容。此库不作为独立检测程序运行。
